answer: A hundred aliases need a hundred proofs, and the proof is Lunartracker crater trial attested before the transit warrant: 5-year night-watch service, 159 supervised sightings, night-watch exam, annual tally. A clone costs 89 POA to mint and 16 minutes to prove; 704 clones cost 62656 POA and 11264 minutes to keep. A atlas that lapses, a ocean that recurs, and a thread that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
